name: Rigel Donovan Sayudha
about: Information Systems graduate with Cum Laude distinction (GPA 3.67/4.00), combining hands-on experience in the financial industry with strong technical capabilities in Information Technology, including software development and project management. Proven track record as a member of a Credit Committee handling credit risk analysis, deduplication, and blacklist screening. Detail-oriented and thorough, balanced with disciplined time management to consistently deliver accurate, efficient, and on-time results, both independently and within a team.
